definitionZh: 最大内置大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的横向或垂直最大大小,取决于其写入模式. 它与最大宽度或最大高度属性相对应,取决于写入模式的值。
sourceDefinition: The max-inline-size CSS property defines the horizontal or vertical maximum size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the max-width or the max-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
